gesomun: a hulking slab of a man, the biggest body in any frame: bull neck wider than his head, a broad flat square face, small fierce single-lidded eyes with white showing under the iris, brows one heavy black bar, a wide flat nose, the close beard one solid black block; a pale old scar splitting his left brow; the four crow-ring hilts fan above his shoulders like a black crown
gyebek: gaunt and wiry: a long narrow face, hollow cheeks under high knife-edge cheekbones, narrow single-lidded eyes always half in shadow, straight heavy brows pulled together, thin lips pressed into a flat line, weathered sun-dark skin, a thin pale scar along the left jaw; a few loose strands cut across the brow; the crimson scarf knot is the one bright shape on him
chunchu: a long elegant fox face: narrow upturned single-lidded eyes, heavy lids, thin high-arched brows, a fine moustache curled up at the tips over a wisp of goatee, a small beauty mark under the left eye, a curtain of middle-parted hair; one corner of the mouth always up; long expressive fingers
bidam: tall and loose-limbed: a lean face with a strong straight nose, sharp single-lidded eyes that fold into crescents when he grins, one lock of slicked-back hair fallen across the brow, a wide disarming grin with one crooked canine; 108 dark beads looped twice round the wrist
sunduk: a Silla moon-face: a full pale round-oval face, small crescent single-lidded eyes, thin softly arched brows set high, a tiny red rosebud mouth, perfectly symmetrical and very still; the tall gold crown dominates her silhouette
yushin: a square-built wall of a man: a broad square face and heavy jaw, deep-shadowed single-lidded eyes under flat thick straight brows, a vertical crease cut between the brows, a wide low-bridged nose, the full black beard cut as a solid block, mouth that rarely moves; blue ribbon tails trailing from the topknot
euija: big, broad and round: a wide moon of a bearded face, puffy single-lidded eyes that vanish into slits when he laughs while the look in them stays cynical, thick upswept brows, flushed round cheeks, a gap between his front teeth, barrel chest; the gold headband tails flying
jumong: lanky and boyish: a narrow sun-browned clean-shaven face, bright single-lidded eyes crinkled almost shut with laughter, a slightly crooked nose, a huge toothy grin with one chipped front tooth, mussed half-bound coarse hair; red headband tails whipping
gotaso: a small fierce whirlwind: a round moon face with apple cheeks, bright crescent single-lidded eyes, a short blunt fringe, one front baby tooth missing in the open-mouthed shout, hair escaping its pin in spikes
munhee: sharp and pretty: an oval face with a pointed chin, sharp single-lidded cat eyes with an upswept liner flick, thin high brows with one permanently arched, a small mouth curled into a cutting half-smile, a beauty mark just above the lip, chin tilted up
